title: Optimized protocol for direct cardiac reprogramming in mice using Ascl1 and Mef2c
protocol: Thaw a new vial of 293T cells on day 0 and seed them such that they will be sub-confluent by day 2.
Subpassage and reseed the 293T cells on day 2 on 10cm dishes so that they will be 70% confluent by day 3.
Coat 10cm tissue culture dishes with 1 × poly-L-lysine by pipetting 5 mL of poly-L-lysine solution into each dish and incubate for 30 min in a 37°C incubator.
Prewarm 293T culture medium and 0.05% Trypsin in a 37°C water bath for 15 min on day 4 based on the number of dishes needed for transfection.
Retrieve the 293T cells from the incubator.
Aspirate the culture medium from each dish, and gently replace with 1× DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS from each dish.
Pipette 3 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA into each dish.
Incubate dishes in a 37°C incubator for 5 min to ensure sufficient dissociation of cells from the plate surface.
Observe the dish under the microscope to confirm cell dissociation.
Pipette 3 mL of warm 293T medium into each dish.
Collect cell suspension from the dish(s) into a conical tube.
Centrifuge conical at 200 × g for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Retrieve poly-L-lysine-coated dish(s) from the incubator.
Aspirate the poly-L-lysin solution as much as possible.
Resuspend 293T cells in warm 293T medium and count the cell number using a hemocytometer.
Adjust the cell suspension to 4 × 10^5 cells/mL using warm 293T medium.
Seed 10 mL of the cell suspension onto the poly-L-lysin-coated dish(s).
Pre-warm viral transfection medium to room temperature (20°C–25°C) on day 4.
Determine the number of dishes needed for each virus based on your experiment design.
Prepare solutions in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube as listed in the protocol table.
Briefly vortex Trans-IT before usage.
Add 50 μL of Trans-IT to each microfuge tube of plasmid/Opti-MEM mix.
Flick each microfuge tube multiple times immediately after adding Trans-IT.
Incubate tubes for 15 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Do not incubate longer than 20 min.
Add 850 μL of Trans-IT/plasmid mix to an individual 10 cm dish drop-wise to different areas of the well.
Gently swirl the dishes in back and forth and side-to-side motion.
Incubate the dishes in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 16–18 h.
Replace the medium with pre-warmed 293T medium.
Collect retroviral-containing medium from each 10cm dish into 50 mL conical tubes.
Store collected medium at 4°C.
Replace the collected medium with pre-warmed 293T medium (8mL per dish).
Return dish(s) to the incubator.
Collect retroviral-containing medium from each 10cm dish and add to the same 50 mL tube from the previous collection.
Centrifuge the virus supernatant at 3,000 × g at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Filter the centrifuged virus supernatant through a 0.45 μm pore size cellulose acetate filter using a sterile disposable syringe.
Transfer the filtered virus supernatant to open-top polypropylene tubes for ultracentrifuge.
Balance the tubes by adding additional medium to the tubes.
Centrifuge the virus supernatant with SW-28 adapter at 23,000 × g, 4°C for 1.5 hours.
Remove all traces of liquid by aspiration.
Add 200 μL of cold, sterile DMEM into the tube and sit it on ice for 1 hour.
Resuspend each viral pellet per tube by pipetting.
The virus is now ready for use.
Aliquot the virus for single use if not used fresh.
Store aliquoted virus at −80°C for at least 1 month.
Bring 5 mL of 10× collagenase II solution to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Determine the number of 24-well plates for your experiment.
Coat plates with 0.1% gelatin solution for seeding of fibroblasts in final step.
Place coated plates in incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Dissect hearts out of P0-P3 mice and place them in a 10cm dish on ice with 1× DPBS.
Wash the hearts once with chilled DPBS to remove blood.
Mince the hearts into small pieces with a razor blade in the Biosafety Cabinet.
Transfer minced hearts into a 15 mL conical tube with 10 mL pre-warmed 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA and incubate at 37°C water bath for 15 min.
Prepare a 1× collagenase II solution by diluting the 10× stock with HBSS and filtering through a 0.45 μm syringe filter.
Equilibrate the 1× collagenase solution to 37°C in a water bath.
Aspirate the trypsin supernatant without disturbing the sediments after 15 min of incubation.
Add 10 mL of warm collagenase II to each tube.
Vortex the tube(s) for 1 min at 40% of the vortexer power.
Incubate the tube(s) in a 37°C water bath for 7 min.
Vortex the tube(s) again for 1 min at 40% of the vortexer power.
Leave the tube upright and undisturbed for 1 min to allow tissue pieces to settle down.
Collect the supernatant from each tube into another tube containing cold 5 mL mouse fibroblast medium.
Store the cell supernatant on ice.
Repeat previous steps for a total of 3–4 cell collections as necessary.
Combine all cell collections and filter through a 40 μm nylon cell strainer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 200 × g, 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL MACS buffer.
Incubate supernatant from cell pellet with antibody mix at 4°C for 30 min with constant gentle mixing.
Add 10 mL of MACS buffer to resuspend the cell and spin at 200 × g for 5 min, 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant from cell pellet and resuspend in microbeads mix.
Incubate the cell-beads mix at 4°C for 30 min with constant gentle mixing.
Add 10 mL of MACS buffer to resuspend the cell and spin at 200 × g for 5 min, 4°C.
Set up a MACS separator in the biosafety cabinet and insert an LS column into the magnetic holder.
Add 3 mL MACS buffer to the LS column to equilibrate it.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL MACS buffer.
Pipette the cell suspension onto the equilibrated column and allow it to pass through by gravity.
Wash the column twice with 1 mL MACS buffer.
Take the LS column off the separator and elute the cells with 5 mL of MACS buffer using the plunger provided with the column.
Spin at 200 × g for 5 min, 4°C.
Resuspend the cell in 5 mL FB medium and count the cell number with a hemocytometer.
Use 0.4% Trypan blue solution to ensure counting of live cells.
Seed 4 × 10^3 cells per well in gelatin-coated 24-well plates.
Place the plates in the incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 for at least 8 h.
Observe the fibroblasts seeded yesterday under a microscope to ensure most of the cells survived and are attached to the plate.
Prepare infection medium for each well of seeded cardiac fibroblasts on day 0 according to protocol.
Aspirate the old medium from the cardiac fibroblasts and replace with infection medium.
Incubate for 24 h in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Prepare new infection medium as above on day 1.
Aspirate the old infection medium and replace with the new infection medium.
Incubate for 24 h in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Aspirate the infection medium on day 2 and replace with 500 μL/well of iCM medium supplemented with 1 μg/mL of puromycin.
Incubate the cells for two days to select cells that have been infected with retrovirus.
Replace the iCM/puromycin medium with fresh iCM medium without puromycin on day 4.
Culture the cells for another 8 days in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Change medium every other day.
Collect reprogrammed cells on day 12 for characterizing iCM phenotype and efficiency by immunostaining.
Incubate reprogrammed cells with anti-cTnT antibody at a dilution of 1:500.
Incubate reprogrammed cells with anti-αActinin antibody at a dilution of 1:500.
Optionally, culture reprogrammed cells in iCM maturation medium for an additional 4 weeks for further characterization.
